pages.myLicenseSubtitle: Activate and verify your license on this device.
pages.myLicenseDeviceHint: Web login does not bind your account to a device; only the Chrome extension binds deviceId on login. License device limits are separate — extension and this site each have their own deviceId (extension: chrome.storage; web: this browser). If you activated in the extension, Verify here may fail until you open this page with ?deviceId=… (same extension UUID) or activate again here (uses another slot if your plan allows).
pages.licenseValidityExplain: Expiry is counted from your first activation of this key, not from when the admin created it. Until someone activates the key, the period does not run.
pages.noLicenseYet: You don't have a license yet.
